OpenAI projects massive cash burn by 2030

Artificial intelligence company OpenAI has projected a cash burn of approximately $280 billion by the year 2030. This forecast, reported by the Financial Times citing a company presentation, highlights the company's significant future funding requirements. The projected expenses are attributed to substantial investments in computing power and infrastructure, as well as facing price pressures in the market. The company anticipates deeply negative cash flows during this period.
